comment: Release-label gate (launch audit XR-LAUNCH-010, owner decision D2, 2026-10-22). XR is labelled "Public beta" until every gate below is "green". `bun run claim-lint` refuses identity.stability = "stable" while any gate is not green, and refuses stable-production wording ("Status: Stable", "production-ready", "generally available") on public surfaces while the label is not stable. A gate turns green only with evidence (CI run URL, hardware report or re-audit verdict) in its `evidence` field. Statuses: open | in-progress | fixed-unverified | green.

gates.title: One canonical public version on every claimed channel
gates.evidence: Phase 1 commit 80007d7f; channel:live 2026-10-22: github-releases, homebrew, winget fail (owner actions pending)

gates.title: Bootstrap installers install a verified release, never main
gates.evidence: Phase 1 commit 80007d7f; Linux clean-HOME verified; macOS/Windows CI added, not yet run

gates.title: Shell confinement on macOS/Windows (D3: native sandboxes)
gates.evidence: Phase 2B: experimental opt-in Seatbelt/AppContainer (XR_OS_SANDBOX=experimental), self-checked; default still refuses; os-sandbox.yml CI not yet run; no hardware; security review pending

gates.title: unshare fallback confines the filesystem or refuses
gates.evidence: Phase 2B: unshare pivot_root + checked mounts + detect self-check; Linux probes SH1/SH2/H1/H2 fail closed in test/trust/namespace-confinement.test.ts (local run 2026-10-22); bwrap rows not run here; security review pending

gates.title: Windows ARM64 file authority (D4)
gates.evidence: Phase 2B: arch gate + FFI self-test. Phase 3: Bun pin raised to 1.4.2 (ships bun:ffi on windows-aarch64, oven-sh/bun#33696); windows-arm64.yml and the windows-11-arm journey legs added as non-gating; not yet run, no hardware

gates.title: Uninstall removes only the rc block XR wrote
gates.evidence: Phase 2A 1fd4a53d: marker-block uninstall; Ubuntu rc fixtures byte-identical (Linux); macOS rc lane in cross-platform.yml not yet run

gates.title: xr update works on npm installs
gates.evidence: Phase 2A 1fd4a53d: npm-pack smoke PASS on Linux; macOS/Windows lanes not yet run

gates.title: Desktop signing, notarization and signed updater
gates.evidence: Phase 2C: signing + updater wired, gated on owner secrets; verify-updater-signatures.ts checks latest.json before publish; no secrets provisioned, builds remain unsigned

gates.title: No demo data on the production desktop path
gates.evidence: Phase 2A 1fd4a53d: production vite build has none of the 7 seed probes (CI gate added); Rust purge unit-tested standalone; full Tauri build first runs in CI

gates.title: Public claims match the label and the live channels
gates.evidence: Phase 2A 1fd4a53d: claim-lint gates 8/9 green offline; --live red until owner marks v1.1.0 pre-release

gates.title: Hardware evidence for every claimed desktop target
gates.evidence: Phase 3: clean-machine journeys (scripts/journey/*, journey.yml, desktop-app.yml journey job) + generated SUPPORT_MATRIX (support-targets.json, --require-complete). Local LR on Linux x64 only (CLI binary + npm, all 7 steps); desktop, Docker, macOS and Windows journeys have not run yet

gates.title: Release gates are blocking, green and test reality
gates.evidence: Phase 3: 6 aggregate gate checks (.github/required-checks.json, owner applies branch protection), no-retry + quarantine policy, ci:policy, release publish needs journey + supply-chain, report-only workflows renamed (non-gating) and fixed to complete. Needs 10 consecutive green main runs
